summary: qs 6.12.0 unintentionally turned on the decodeDotInKeys option by default, so a percent-encoded dot in a key was decoded during parsing; 6.12.1 restored the previous default.

demoRepros.broken: assert(false, "I have not isolated the regression yet");
demoRepros.weak:
const parsed = Qs.parse("a=b");
assert(parsed.a === "b", "basic query parsing should work");
demoRepros.real:
const parsed = Qs.parse("a%252Eb=c");
assert(Object.keys(parsed).length === 1 && parsed["a%2Eb"] === "c", "encoded dots must stay encoded by default");
